scope: CP-2G Forward credit model: CP-0, CP-1, CP-2A (required) and CP-1D (optional) over the frozen financial pack, CP-2G consuming the frozen CP-2A and CP-1D facts under their D3 pins
status: DRAFT revision 2 (fix round 1 on review-precise-1) by the cp2g-owner preparation task, 2026-10-28; scoped re-review pending; not executed
raw_rule: Literal UTF-8 LF, no terminal LF per page; U+000C joins ordered pages for the source SHA256 (same rule as cases/financial/manifest.json)

sources.reuse: Every page text and locator stays byte-identical; read by reference, never edited
Every page text and locator stays byte-identical; read by reference, never edited

bridge_source.reuse: the CP-1D positive bridge pages, byte-identical, in the pack of the positive and cp1d_blocked runs (CP-1D needs them); the gap, refused, blocked and cp2a_blocked runs use the identity and financial sources only
bridge_source.check: builder asserts the U+000C-joined page sha256 equals the pinned value

tamper: expected.json#tamper: the positive closed run, CP-2G result Module fact T2H.7.b03.down_first forged FY2026 -> Not reached by FY2028 (frozen CP-DR shape)
no_new_source: CP-2G reads the settled CP-1, CP-2A and CP-1D heads only and opens no SourceSession; no synthetic source is added by this lease. The analyst driver values are literal submission input.

edges.decision: D4: methodology.json as is. CP-2G required CP-0, CP-1, CP-2A (rule block); optional CP-1D, CP-2D (rule restricted); no edge_rules entry. The r14 skill also lists CP-1B and CP-2 as advisory; methodology.json does not and this lease does not add them.
edges.input_order: execution.current_inputs binds prepared-pack then the upstream heads in plan order: positive [prepared-pack, CP-0, CP-1, CP-1D, CP-2A]; gap [prepared-pack, CP-0, CP-1, CP-2A]

positive.execution: closed run: CP-0, CP-1 (five stages), CP-1D (frozen CP-1D positive), CP-2A (frozen CP-2A positive), CP-2G; CP-1D bound and read

gap.execution: closed run: CP-0, CP-1, CP-2A (frozen CP-2A positive), CP-2G; CP-1D not requested (optional edge unbound), minimum liquidity not assessed

cp1d_blocked.submission: submissions.json cases.cp1d_blocked (positive-derived: minimum liquidity 10, an assessment that names no CP-1D figure)
cp1d_blocked.execution: closed run: CP-1D settles blocked (CP-1D refusals r06 twice); CP-2A positive; CP-2G begins under the restricted edge with Input CP-1D status blocked

refused.execution: CP-0 only; CP-1 begin raises NotAuthorized; CP-2A and CP-2G are never begun

blocked.execution: closed run to CP-2A, then CP-2G attempt 0 invalid (rejected) and attempt 1 invalid (blocked)

cp2a_blocked.submission: cases/cp2a-owner/submissions.json refusals r01 then v13 for CP-2A
cp2a_blocked.execution: closed run to CP-1, then CP-2A settles blocked; CP-2G begin raises ValueError('Required upstream is unrun, stale or blocked') (edge rule block)

fixture_total_loss.execution: composer only: positive CP-1 facts, CP-2A positive scenario s04 (EBITDA falls to zero) as the downside

fixture_cash_missing.execution: composer only: the positive CP-1 facts with cash_closing set to status missing (limitation 'Cash and cash equivalents are not disclosed in the supplied statements.')

fixture_debt_repaid.execution: composer only: the whole term loan repaid in the first year, so debt is a known zero and coverage and FCF-to-debt are not calculable

fixture_cp2a_gap_head.execution: composer only: CP-1 positive facts with the frozen CP-2A gap head (base period Q3 25; break b02 and b03 required declines missing)

fact_selection_rule.predicate: fact.table_id == 'T4.10' and fact.label == 'LTM Q4 25 (2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31) · <metric>'; exactly one match per metric (probe: 500 T4.10 facts, unique labels), zero or several fail
fact_selection_rule.sign: CP-1 stores cash_interest, cash_taxes, working_capital_change and capex as negative outflows; CP-2G uses their magnitudes
fact_selection_rule.probe: S1 positive promoted CP-1 head (read only copy r2pos-orig), 2026-10-28, LTM Q4 25 column: revenue 120, ebitda 30.0, cash_interest -5.00, cash_taxes -4, working_capital_change -2.0, capex -10.0, fcf 9.00, total_debt 50.00, cash_closing 20.00, undrawn_rcf 0, ebitda_margin 0.25, capex_to_revenue 0.0833...; all known; the other upstream facts are literal ids (below)
fact_selection_rule.fact_ids: interface-fact:<sha256>; bound at run time, never literal

CP-2A.head: the settled CP-2A head of the run
CP-2A.scenario: T2B.1.<row>.ebitda_decline and T2B.1.<row>.interest_increase of the row named by downside.scenario
CP-2A.breaks: T2B.6.<row>.{origin,test,level,required_decline,outcome} for every row of the register, in register order
CP-2A.fact_ids: literal (table.row.field assigned by CP-2A); read from cases/cp2a-owner/expected.json cases.positive (pinned)

CP-1D.head: the settled CP-1D head of the run

run_time_bindings.figure_placeholders: {{FIG:name|token}} -> {<fact_id>|<token>}: cp1 names by fact_selection_rule, cp1d names to the literal ids above; only a fact with a citation or a calculation can be referenced in prose, so the uncited analyst cells of CP-2A (shock sizes, watch levels) are never FIG names; unreplaced it is malformed run text (refusal v11)
run_time_bindings.fact_id_marker: {{FACT_ID:name}} in an expected issue -> the fact id bound to FIG name
run_time_bindings.cp0_consumer_rows: positive and cp1d_blocked: CP-1, CP-1D (cases/cp1d-owner submissions positive.readiness_review.consumers), CP-2A (submissions.json cp0_consumer_row_cp2a) and CP-2G (cp0_consumer_row_cp2g); gap, blocked, cp2a_blocked: CP-1 (default), CP-2A, CP-2G; T8 commands Run <module> for each
run_time_bindings.cp1_readiness: submissions.json cases.<case>.cp1_readiness (consumer entries CP-1D?, CP-2A, CP-2G); markers bound by the frozen run_time_bindings of the CP-1D and CP-2A manifests; {{EVID:kpi <key>, LTM Q4 25 basis}} for the new CP-2G entry: the one kpi catalogue record with that key whose display_basis_id is the basis record (kind basis, label 'LTM Q4 25', column_key 'LTM:fy-2025', scope 'historical')

tool_use.CP-2G: session-less and source-free: no SourceSession and no pack tool; the only tool use is one ok read_inputs (the exact view context_block, a D2 exception frozen by this lease) before the submit; every invoke is a refused not_permitted receipt

view_tree_draft.note: a proposal, not an observation: the implementer commits cases/cp2g-owner/cp2g-view-tree.json from a product-settled head; no quote, citations or record_json key at any depth

keys.upstream: [{module_id, status}] for CP-0, CP-1, CP-2A and CP-1D (state bound|unbound|blocked)
keys.base: {period, forecast_periods: [FY2026, FY2027, FY2028], operands: {revenue, ebitda, cash_interest, cash_taxes, working_capital_change, capex, fcf, total_debt, cash_closing, undrawn_rcf: {ref|null, shown|null, status, limitation|null}}, ratios: {ebitda_margin, capex_to_revenue, total_leverage_reported, net_leverage_reported, interest_coverage_reported, fcf_to_debt: {...}}}
keys.drivers: [{name, label, unit_class, bounds: {min, max, places}}] for the seven drivers; minimum_liquidity: {places, may_be_not_assessed: true}
keys.cp2a: {base_period, scenarios: [{row, name, ebitda_decline: {shown, status}, interest_increase: {shown, status}}], breaks: [{row, origin, test, level: {shown, status}, required_decline: {shown|null, status, limitation|null}, outcome}]}
keys.cp1d: {state, supported_ebitda: {ref, shown}|null, supported_total_leverage: {ref, shown}|null, supported_net_leverage: {ref, shown}|null}
keys.break_metrics_offered: [total_leverage, net_leverage, interest_coverage]; the rows b01 and b02 (origin Definition) are fixed and not offered
keys.cp1_facts: [{ref, label, period, unit, shown}] referencable CP-1 operands and ratios (a fact with a citation or calculation only)
keys.cp1d_facts: [{ref, label, period, unit, shown}] referencable CP-1D facts (T1D.3.supported.value, T1D.6.supported.total_leverage, T1D.6.supported.net_leverage) when bound
